questions.query: interiorDescription
questions.why: getImage parameter interiorDescription: used to identify the interiorId when it cannot be resolved (premium/enterprise)

questions.query: transmission param, automatic or manual
questions.why: Shared transmission parameter on getImage and getCarListing: type of transmission, automatic or manual

questions.query: Is the width parameter capped on a freemium or limited licence?
questions.why: getImage width parameter: freemium limited to 400, limited licence to 400 and 800

questions.query: margins default value and max
questions.why: DATA POINTS table row margins: defaults to 0.02 (2%), decimal 0 to 0.4, premium/enterprise

questions.query: position=horizon vs center vs bottom, does it work on 360 or lifestyle shots
questions.why: DATA POINTS table row position: horizon/center/bottom, fine tune with groundPlaneAdjustment, not for 360 or lifestyle

questions.query: what happens if I set safeMode=false
questions.why: DATA POINTS row safeMode and spec safeMode (default true): prevents cut-off from zoom/margins/groundPlaneAdjustment; false allows intended cut-off

questions.query: getPaints result: orderable vs available flag
questions.why: Paragraph under getPaints RETURNS JSON: orderable = offered by manufacturer; available (target=car) = already rendered or rendered on first request

questions.query: imageURL field in the paint swatch JSON, when is it filled
questions.why: Response Structure table: imageURL optional, link to an image file when the swatch is a complex texture

questions.query: angle=216
questions.why: Collapsed table of 32 interactive angles: 216 is position 17 of 32, straight-on rear view at eye level

questions.query: pspc meaning
questions.why: Terminology table first row: pspc = primary spray can color (spc = spray can color)

questions.query: Which generic imagin-* paint codes exist besides imagin-white, e.g. is there an imagin-orange?
questions.why: Paints FAQ third row: list of generic paintIds imagin-black/grey/white/blue/yellow/red/orange/green

questions.query: send a custom Referer with axios when calling the image endpoint
questions.why: Axios example: axios.create with baseURL and get(..., { headers: { Referer } })

questions.query: How do I put together an image link for a web page: which part identifies my account, which part describes the car and which part controls the look?
questions.why: 'the URL' section: four sections END POINT, IDENTIFICATION, CAR, CUSTOMISATION plus colour-coded example URL

questions.query: which settings tab of the web portal shows my customer key
questions.why: Dashboard FAQ: customer key is in dashboard settings (CDN/API)

questions.query: the car fills too much of the frame on one static shot, how do I pull it back a little
questions.why: zoomLevel page (numeric level, only with zoomType=relative, single static angles) and DATA POINTS zoomLevel row (0-30, not with fullscreen/adaptive)

questions.query: generate descriptive alt attributes for car photos so they rank in search
questions.why: Programmatic Alt Text Implementation: build alt text from make, modelFamily, modelYear, paintDescription in your front-end

questions.query: Our marketing team can't code. Is there a way for them to browse the car pictures and copy a link into our CMS?
questions.why: IMAGIN.STUDIO SUITE section: browse offering and grab image URLs for a CMS at dashboard.imagin.studio

questions.query: We just started integrating and matches look all over the place. Can we hand you a spreadsheet of our stock to get it learning faster?
questions.why: Both have the getting-started tip: an initial car data export (CSV) speeds up the initial data training

questions.query: get a photo looking straight at the back of the car
questions.why: Angle description tables: 13 is straight-on rear (bumper height), 216 straight-on rear at eye level

questions.query: split image costs per department on our invoice
questions.why: billingTag: DATA POINTS row (business unit to cross bill) and CAP HPI optional parameters table (associate call with a business unit)

questions.query: show the vehicle with Dutch number plates
questions.why: countryCode: DATA POINTS row (ISO code, country based plates, sample NL) and shared spec parameter (delivery region changes licence plate/lights)

questions.query: How should I handle a colour name that contains spaces or a # sign when I put it in the request?
questions.why: Safe characters FAQ: safe, reserved (; / ? : @ = &) and unsafe characters (space, ", #, % ...)

questions.query: If someone hammers my website with junk traffic, do your pictures go down with it?
questions.why: DDoS FAQ: delivered via CloudFront with DDoS protection, artificial spikes blocked automatically

questions.query: how far back in time does your catalogue go, can I get a car from ten years ago
questions.why: Coverage FAQ (focus on vehicles from 2017) and Comprehensive Model Coverage (2016 and earlier for key vehicles)

questions.query: Can I advertise a model on my site before it even reaches dealers?
questions.why: New cars FAQ and Data Training CAR MODELS CREATION: images shown well before release for pre-sales; Our Features: imagery available right after release announcements

questions.query: Our feed is missing the fuel type for some cars. Is it fine to fill the gap with something like n/a so every field has a value?
questions.why: All three say: never send 'default'/'unknown', omit the attribute or leave it empty

questions.query: do the bigger subscriptions work out cheaper per picture
questions.why: Contracts FAQ: four levels, higher levels cost more per month but have a lower price per unit at high volume

questions.query: Will the browser block my front-end script from reading your JSON because my site is on another domain?
questions.why: CORS headers FAQ: Allow-Origin * and Expose-Headers * on images and JSON APIs, any site can read the output

questions.query: Is this meant to replace hiring a photographer to shoot every car in our showroom?
questions.why: What We Do intro: removes the need for costly photoshoots by linking car data to a studio image library

questions.query: Do lookups for colour lists and the available-cars list count towards my bill?
questions.why: Hint at the bottom: getCarListing, getPaints and getPaintSwatches show up in usage but are not charged
